body:
This is a part port and part rewrite of the [RS485/Logistics Pipes](https://github.com/RS485/LogisticsPipes) mod, mostly from around commit [5d5b8d6](https://github.com/RS485/LogisticsPipes/tree/5d5b8d6e7489a0cc8ddc4b330e76e22b4696bda2) for Minecraft Release 1.3.2

---

Logistics Pipes is an extension of Buildcraft pipes allowing you to build complex systems for transporting, routing and sorting items.

The mod provides many pipes and modules each fullfilling a unique purpose to build your logistics network.

A small Logistics Pipe setup showcasing chests, autocrafting using auto workbenches and a furnace and a request pipe:

![A small Logistics Pipe](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/3600239e1e0eccc074343e64230b44a0fec20823.webp)
